q: How do I calculate the carbon footprint of a decorative laminate sheet?
title: Decorative laminate carbon footprint per sheet
short: Add the kraft paper, decor paper and phenolic and melamine resins per sheet with supplier figures. Add impregnation, drying and pressing energy, divide the plant's energy by sheets passed and state sheet size and thickness.

ul: Multi-daylight hot press with steam or thermic oil.

p: Report per sheet by size and thickness, usually 8 by 4 feet. The resins and papers usually carry most of the footprint.

example.title: Worked example: decorative laminate unit per sheet (one month)
lines: Plant total: 202,000 / 100,000 = 2.020 kg CO2 per sheet
Add papers and resins for the full figure
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; use your own bills and production records.

senseible: Senseible reads the plant's electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and fuel invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, the plant-level input to a per-unit figure. Bought-in materials go to the supplier evidence trail; product reports are self-declared drafts.
